judgment.notes: The complete proposed endpoint has n : ℕ, E : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), and exactly E.Nonempty, IsCompact E, and the redundant 0 ≤ n. This matches the approved nonempty compact Euclidean set for every n≥0, including n=0. There are no external E roots, extra field/order instances, finiteness hypotheses, measurability requirements on E/covers, or positive-dimension assumptions. H003 is redundant and need not be used by a local obligation. T001/T002/T006 have no project inputs; all remaining conditional T inputs are earlier proved obligations or H001/H002, so they introduce no new H. Independently checked the pinned definitions: PiL2.lean:113–114 defines EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι as PiLp 2 over the index type ι, and :160–166 gives the square-sum Euclidean distance. Thus Fin k, not the Lp exponent 2, determines dimension; k=0 is the singleton empty-coordinate space. Fin.snoc/Fin.castSucc/Fin.last implement first k coordinates and the final coordinate, including k=0 (Tuple/Basic.lean:496–532). GPproduct is exactly the coordinate-appended E×I in both directions: T001 explicitly requires both inverse identities, the Euclidean distance identity and projection contractions. GPI is the real closed interval with both endpoints; its set-to-type coercion in T017 is the subtype {t : ℝ // t∈GPI}, not an unrestricted or empty domain. Using ℝ for D006 is the same real-line metric; T002 separately compares real-line GPmass to native measure, so T014–T017 never apply Euclidean-only T003 to a real set. Metric.ediam is the supremum of pairwise edists, including zero on empty sets (EMetricSpace/Diam.lean:32–69). The pinned ENNReal Pow instance is rpow; positive exponents give zero at zero and top at top. ENNReal.tsum_eq_iSup_sum gives precisely the finite-subsum supremum. Consequently GPcover/GPcost/GPcontent/GPmass are D002–D003 on positive exponents/scales with arbitrary covers and empty padding. T002 is an assigned equality proof, in both ambient families, rather than a definitional assumption: its plan removes the nonempty summand guard using s>0, identifies finite positive radii by ofReal/toReal and bounds the top-radius term by radius 1. Native dimH is exactly the Borel supremum over NNReal exponents with infinite native Hausdorff measure (HausdorffDimension.lean:94–130), matching D004–D005 without truncating dimension. ofReal truncates negative reals, but every scale/threshold is positive and dimH E < ofReal q forces q>0; hence those guards have the source meaning. T009/T011/T015 use finite ediam.toReal only under GPcover bounds by finite ofReal scales; the plan explicitly requires reconstruction. T003 supplies the positive-exponent NNReal cast conversion. T006 guards the conditional real sSup/sInf by nonemptiness and proves boundedness plus actual IsLUB/IsGLB properties, avoiding their arbitrary values on unbounded sets. None of these definitions contains a conclusion or an extra project assumption. These are faithful planned conversion obligations; their proof bodies remain due at assembly.

N001/T003 retains normalization, nonnegativity, both critical-exponent implications, both converses, positive-scale antitonicity, arbitrarily cheap covers and arbitrarily large contents at bounded scales, each with its original guard. T004/T005 retain the positive coordinate box, finite ball covers and finite content, and prove rather than assume 0≤D≤n, D<top and the n=0 singleton conclusion via the source grid construction. T006 preserves nonempty B, finite real ρ≥0, the full pairwise bound, η>0 and the exact enlarged sup/inf endpoints with length≤ρ+η; it explicitly proves the endpoint bound properties. T007–T010 keep n=0 separate from 1≤n, retain q>D, 0<r≤1 and ε>0 in the cover estimates, and obtain all N004 zero-content/zero-mass clauses only at q>D. T008's empty padding is equivalent to the source countable family of nonempty members after restriction, since q>0; T009 explicitly plans the restriction, dependent finite subdivision and enumeration back to ℕ. T011 retains arbitrary V, positive s,δ,ε and the whole covering/diameter condition; it outputs projection contraction and interval enclosures even for zero diameters. T012–T013 use those intervals, finite c from N002, measurable constant indicators, countable Tonelli without integrability assumptions, ε-removal and the infimum over all covers to prove exactly N005. T014–T017 retain interval dimension 1, infinite mass for every 0<s<1, and the complete N006 embedding clause for arbitrary k,A,e, with image containment and distance preservation explicitly as antecedents, plus content comparison for every s,δ>0. The real-line native comparison is available from T002; Euclidean T003 is used for A. T018 keeps D>0 and uses N001/N002/N005 with s↑D; T019 keeps D=0 and uses the legitimate H001 point and the T001 isometry to instantiate N006, including n=0. T020 splits those cases and combines lower bounds with N004 by antisymmetry. Thus the full P, universally quantified in n,E under H001–H003, is exactly dimH(GPproduct E)=dimH E+1, with addition in ENNReal. No conditional worker input remains a proposed external theorem, and no necessary defining field assumes an output. The source arguments give concrete local routes for the difficult obligations; their being unproved at this stage is not an interface defect.
